description: Extension methods for CronJobEditor class to handle UI binding, data hydration, payload construction, validation, and scheduling logic related to cron jobs in a macOS application.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled Text view with label text.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's properties from an existing job object, decoding various nested job properties.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Builds and saves the payload, with error handling.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a payload dictionary representing the current state for saving, handling validation errors.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Constructs a delivery options dictionary based on current delivery mode and settings.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates that the name field is non-empty.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Builds the schedule dictionary based on the selected schedule kind and related properties.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload part of the job based on user selections.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates the compatibility between session target and payload kind.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Ensures required fields are present depending on payload type.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets deleteAfterRun flag in the payload based on schedule kind.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload object for an agent turn.
